genius.notes: Evidence as of 2026-10-07: the 18 September 2026 terms identify Crown Sociedade Prestadora de Serviços de Ativos Virtuais Ltda. as the ordinary issuer; Crown (BVI) Ltd. issues only in specifically agreed cases. KRONA TWO, the Luxembourg reserve guarantor, has a separate role. Crown describes a pending Brazilian Central Bank VASP authorization and grandfathered operations. These issuer disclosures establish no GENIUS approval, state qualification or OCC foreign-issuer registration. No token-specific U.S. authorization or foreign-exception registration was located in the bounded public-source review. GENIUS implementation remains pre-effective. Treasury distinguishes foreign-issuer restrictions at Act effectiveness from the general DASP restriction on 18 July 2028. The live transparency hub publishes a monthly report series through September 2026. The September report, dated 30 September, reports 100.00% coverage and is signed by Rodrigo Molin da Silva with CRC PR-052428/O-CNAI 10106. Its stated procedures are technical proof-of-reserves verification; no recognized accounting assurance standard or GENIUS compliance opinion is stated. monthlyAttestationPresent records the publicly available monthly report series only. Signer credentials, professional assurance classification and statutory attestation adequacy remain independently unverified. Earlier August reports have a different technical signer.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public token-specific GENIUS permitted-issuer approval, state qualification, official GENIUS application or OCC foreign-issuer registration was found for BRLV, Crown BR or Crown (BVI) Ltd. in the reviewed directories, current implementation materials, issuer disclosures and bounded official-site searches. The OCC directory is a pending national-bank application list, not a complete GENIUS register; NYDFS licensing and Greenlist entries are not themselves GENIUS qualification. Neither directory names Crown/BRLV. Brazilian authorization under application and a Luxembourg reserve-guarantor structure do not supply U.S. GENIUS status. This is dated negative evidence, not a declaration of illegality or a guarantee that no unpublished or differently named record exists.
